info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Trade Clearing Review-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of trade clearing reviews, crucial for ensuring compliance and operational efficiency in banking market operations. Users can submit reviews linked to specific trade clearing identifiers, enhancing oversight and accountability in trade processing. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and compliance officers who need to manage trade risks and validate trade executions. The endpoint allows for systematic tracking and handling of review processes essential in the trading environment.

post.summary: Submit a review for a trade clearing operation.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the specified trade clearing operation identified by RES-100045. Providing valuable feedback helps improve the trade clearing processes and services offered.
